title: Hero
description: Canonical definition of a hero consumed by the engine. Mirrors `IHero` (Heroes.Core/Units/Heroes/IHero.cs) plus the metadata needed by JSON-driven catalogs (factionId) and the image asset store (imagePath).

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this hero (kebab-case). Used as the catalog key.

factionId.description: Identifier of the faction this hero belongs to, e.g. 'castle' or 'rampart'. Reflects the faction folder hardcoded heroes live under in Heroes.Core/Units/Heroes/<Faction>/<Class>/.

classId.description: Identifier of the hero class within the faction, e.g. 'knight' or 'ranger'. Reflects the class folder hardcoded heroes live under in Heroes.Core/Units/Heroes/<Faction>/<Class>/. Optional.

stateLine.description: Base hero stats. Mirrors `HeroStateLine` (Heroes.Core/Units/Heroes/HeroStateLine.cs); the engine wires these into the Attack and Defence abilities that buff allied units in battle.

attack.description: Bonus added to allied unit attack during battle (`HeroStateLine.Attack`).

defence.description: Bonus added to allied unit defence during battle (`HeroStateLine.Defence`).

wisdom.description: Determines learnable spell tier and starting mana — engine sets initial Mana = wisdom * 10 unless `mana` is overridden.

mana.description: Starting mana points (`IHero.Mana`). Optional — when omitted the engine derives it from `stateLine.wisdom * 10`, matching current hardcoded hero behavior.

startingSpells.description: Ids of spells the hero starts with in their spell book (`IHero.SpellBook`). Currently all hardcoded heroes start with an empty list; reserved for future spell catalogs.

abilities.description: Ids of extra abilities/specialties beyond the default Attack and Defence stat-bonus abilities every hero gets automatically (see Christian.cs / Clancy.cs). Reserved for hero specialties — empty for the current set.

imagePath.description: Relative path of the hero's portrait asset, resolved through D9bolic.Assets IImageStore. Populated in T8 — heroes may omit this field until image assets are wired up.
